summary.text: Star cloud storm is a flying-star phenomenon that originated in immemorial blue heaven and also appears in immemorial black heaven.

claims.text: Central Continent’s Immortal Gu Houses are resting on a heaven attached fungi field in immemorial black heaven when a blue starlight shows in the distance like diamonds set in black silk, and Wei Ling Yang calls the approaching mass a huge star cloud storm. Countless stars fly through it, some trailing long tails and the largest the size of islands or whole stretches of land, with specks of starlight woven between them like lightning.

The phenomenon was unique to immemorial blue heaven. After that heaven shattered, large numbers of stars fell into immemorial black heaven. Bi Chen Tian says this is the first time he is seeing a star cloud storm of this scale, and that the heaven attached fungi field was a trap to lure them to rest.

The storm’s range is too huge, fast, and powerful for the three Immortal Gu Houses to escape. They fly toward it and are swallowed. Stars fly endlessly while lightning clouds rumble and starlight shoots out. Inside, uncountable star path dao marks disrupt information path communication. Huge stars move quickly. A collision can send a house flying and separate it from the others. Between the stars a chaotic magnetic field repels, attracts, and crushes. Even Wind Sweeping Building’s strongest method is not enough, and Bi Chen Tian cannot tell when they will escape.

After a long time with no stars crashing, Wind Sweeping Building finds the storm moving away through calm dark night. Star path dao marks fill the storm, and those conflicting dao marks make Bi Chen Tian’s methods very ineffective. He follows an aura from Zhao Lian Yun’s love Immortal Gu to escape. Wei Ling Yang leads Canary Pavilion through with difficulty and leaves after Bi Chen Tian, then is ambushed by a sky chief beast group.
